title: Chapter -29 | Lab Result Theory Se Kam Kyun Aata Hai? | Percentage Yield Chemistry #shorts
desc:
Theory bol rahi thi 36 g product milna chahiye…

Lab mein mila sirf 30 g. 😳

Toh reaction actually kitni successful thi?

Isi ko measure karta hai Percentage Yield.

Formula:

Percentage Yield = (Actual Yield ÷ Theoretical Yield) × 100

Hamare example mein:

Actual Yield = 30 g
Theoretical Yield = 36 g

(30 ÷ 36) × 100 ≈ 83.3%

Matlab theoretical maximum product ka approximately 83.3% actually obtain hua. 🧪

title: Why Don’t Magnets Lose Their Power? 🧲
desc:
Why don’t magnets lose their power? 🧲

Unlike a battery, a permanent magnet doesn’t simply run out of energy. Its magnetism comes from the alignment of tiny magnetic domains inside the material.

But magnets can weaken — especially when exposed to strong heat or powerful magnetic fields.

The science behind everyday objects is pretty fascinating. 🔬

title: Why do some people need a cigarette to poop? 🚽
desc:
Nicotine reaches your gut through your blood, activates nerve receptors and releases acetylcholine, which makes your colon squeeze. Over time, your body links smoking with the toilet, and the ritual becomes a cue. But your gut adapts, quitting can cause temporary constipation, and nicotine is not a safe laxative.

📚 Sources: Mandl et al. (2007), Brain Research Bulletin; Coulie et al. (2001), Alimentary Pharmacology & Therapeutics; GoodRx review of nicotine and gut effects.
